entities.name: Quintus Caecilius Metellus Creticus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Quintus Caecilius Metellus Creticus was a politically active member of the Roman upper class. He was praetor in 74 BC and pontifex from 73 BC until his death. He was consul in 69 BC along with Quintus Hortensius Hortalus.
